title: Why did my QR transfer fail?
summary: This document explains why a QR transfer may fail, focusing on limits ($1,250 per transaction and $3,000 daily cap) and common causes (closing the payment screen early, connectivity interruptions, invalid/damaged QR data). It provides resolution steps including reducing amount, waiting for reset, keeping the app open, and requesting a regenerated QR.
faqs: Why won’t my QR transfer go through—could I be over the $1,250 per-transaction limit?
